notes.subject: עלמות לבן
notes.rationale: Taitel i gat planti minings: 'long dai bilong pikinini man' (JPS 'Muthlabben'), 'olsem olman i dai', o nem bilong singsing; no wan i winim olgeta.

notes.subject: עלמות
notes.rationale: Dispela taitel i kamap long Tanakh long hia tasol; mining i stap tait.

translation: Bilong man i lukautim ⟨ol singsing⟩, long dai bilong pikinini man — mizmor bilong David.

tokens.gloss: bilong man i lukautim ol singsing
